whatChanged: Added data.pointLocations with the coordinates of both points (London 51.51, -0.13; red-sky point 51.51, -2.29). Version 1 named the second point only by id (location-london-west-150km), so its coordinates were outside the hash. Correction-family member id updated to v2. Nothing else changed.
reason: Found while writing the fetcher, which refuses to fetch any point whose coordinates are not inside a verified lock. The coordinates had been fixed in the generator script on 2026-10-04 but were not part of the locked content, so they could have been changed later without breaking the v1 hash.
consequence: v1 is superseded and will never be tested. v2 takes v1's slot in the six-member Holm family; the other five locks still list the v1 id, and this deviation is the mapping. Filed before any weather data was fetched.
